About UsWhat if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.Your role & MissionAs a Senior Backend Engineer in our Shipment team, you will build the “brain” behind our logistics operations. You’ll maintain and evolve a sophisticated event-driven architecture designed to answer one crucial question: “How do we move this shipment most efficiently?”From contract rate management to automated shipment nomination, you will lead the charge in creating reliable, data-heavy systems that optimize our global portfolio. You aren’t just writing code; you’re building a revenue-driving engine. Working alongside industry experts, you will mentor your team to deliver robust services that enable NVOCCs to thrive. If you are passionate about leading teams to solve massive logistical challenges, we want to hear from you.What you will do- Design and implement robust backend services for capturing, storing, and validating procurement contract rates and allotment volumes, ensuring 100% data integrity for our supply chain logic.- Lead the evolution of our event-driven microservices to process high-velocity data, enabling real-time updates on contract utilization and space availability.- Refactor and optimize existing systems responsible for shipment-to-contract matching to ensure low-latency performance and high maintainability.- Build and iterate on the logic that answers “Which contract should we use?” by automating the nomination process based on cost, volume commitments, and carrier performance.- Streamline the ingestion and management of complex carrier agreements, moving from manual entry toward a fully automated, API-driven roadmap.- Develop tools that provide dynamic visibility into our capacity vs. demand, allowing the business to shift volumes proactively to meet carrier volume commitments.- Collaborate on integrating ML models for capacity forecasting, helping the team predict future space requirements and steer shipments more intelligently.- Lead initiatives between Engineering, Product, and the Global Procurement team to ensure our technical roadmap aligns with logistics market trends and revenue goals.- Foster a culture of excellence by coaching team members in best practices for backend engineering, domain-driven design, and navigating the complexities of the logistics domain.Required Skills and Experience- Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis, particularly as they apply to large-scale data processing and financial calculations.- Proven professional software craftsmanship, with a focus on building high-quality, maintainable, and testable code (an understanding of TDD is a plus).- Expertise in designing and implementing large-scale, event-driven microservices architectures and robust APIs, with a keen understanding of data consistency in distributed systems.- Deep understanding of synchronous vs. asynchronous communication patterns and their impact on system performance and reliability- Hands-on experience developing distributed backend applications, with a strong focus on data consistency, system quality, low latency, and high availability.- Proficiency in Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles and their application in microservices, with hands-on experience in backend technologies such as Node.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB.- Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration for deploying and managing scalable pricing services.- Experience with cloud providers (AWS or GCP preferred) for deploying and managing highly available and scalable applications.- A collaborative, team-oriented mindset with strong critical product thinking and a sense of ownership over the accuracy and effectiveness of pricing data.- Fluent in English, both verbal and written, for effective communication within a global team.Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit! Why work with us?Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Systemintegration, Datenbankadministration, -management, -organisation, Datenschutz, Informatik

jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant / Manager - Risk Management (Liquidity and Market Price Risk) (f|m|x) (Leiter/in - Risikomanagement)
jobs.description: As a Senior Consultant / Manager (f|m|x), you advise our clients inthe banking sector and financial services industry on complex topicsrelated to liquidity and market price risk. You analyze their currentsituation, identify new requirements early on and, together with yourteam, develop tailored solutions – from the initial idea all the wayto implementation. In this role, you effectively drive the continueddevelopment of your clients’ liquidity risk management, enablingwell‑founded decision-making. You assume subject-matterresponsibility, manage collaboration within the project and shape thecontent development of our consulting approaches. Your tasks: Yousupport and lead exciting (sub-)projects at banks and financialservices providers in their liquidity and market price riskmanagement, taking full responsibility – from gap analyses and thedesign of client-specific solutions through to implementation. Youdevelop integrated management approaches for liquidity and marketprice risk, bank-wide liquidity risk stress tests and quantitativemodeling frameworks, for example for risk measurement or interestrate, margin and liquidity cash flow analyses. In addition, you designmethodological frameworks (for example in the ILAAP context) anddevelop solutions to implement IRRBB and CSRBB requirements as well asnet interest income (NII) simulations. As part of your role, you alsoensure the effective integration of regulatory requirements, forinstance with respect to ICAAP and ILAAP as well as IRRBB and CSRBB.You take responsibility for your own deliverables and those of yourteam and proactively advance topics. With your strong team orientationand professionalism, you foster trust-based collaboration – bothwithin the team and with our clients. You also mentor juniorcolleagues, developing both their professional capabilities andpersonal strengths, and thus contribute to the team’s growth. Youactively help shape the ongoing enhancement of our consultingportfolio, identify relevant market potential at an early stage andderive concrete ideas from it. With your expertise, you support thedevelopment of new offerings and the acquisition of new clientmandates. Your skills: You hold a degree in mathematics, (business)informatics, physics, statistics or economics, ideally supplemented bycertifications such as FRM or CFA. You have at least three years ofprofessional experience in consulting or the financial industry.Proven involvement in leading bank-specific implementation projects inliquidity and market price risk management is an advantage, andinitial exposure to specialist leadership (for example coordinatingteam members) is also part of your profile. You have a solidunderstanding of liquidity and market price risk management as well asthe ICAAP and ILAAP frameworks. You confidently apply your analyticaland quantitative skills in modeling and data analysis; programmingskills in Python or R are explicitly welcome. You are familiar withrelevant European and German regulatory requirements, including EBAGuidelines on IRRBB and CSRBB, SREP requirements, ICAAP and ILAAP.Initial experience in dealing professionally with external audits is aplus. You work and think in a structured and solution-oriented mannerand communicate clearly. A client- and team-oriented way of workingcomes naturally to you, especially when assuming responsibility withina team and engaging effectively with different people and situations.You have excellent command of the German language (at least C1 level,business-fluent proficiency) and good English language skills (atleast B2 level, fluent), both written and spoken. #LI-LARA #LI-hybridYour benefits Insurances & Pension Schemes: Safely on the road withzeb—in Germany, you are also privately insured via a group accidentinsurance policy. For business trips abroad, there is an additionaltravel health insurance and you can also take out a company pensionplan with zeb. Mobile Work: Thanks to our technical equipment, remotework is possible from anywhere – regardless of whether you are onthe train, at home or in the office. zeb.life: Your life ischanging—and we would like to accompany you through the differentphases. zeb.life offers you support for example in childcare, lifesituation management and eldercare or in finding concierge services.Working Time Models: The principle of "trust-based hours” appliesfor all our employees, enabling flexible schedules. For permanentemployees, part-time models are also possible: you can develop yourpart-time model in consultation with your CDC (Career DevelopmentCounselor) and in consideration of your project and adapt it asrequired. Define your working time model according to your personalneeds and adapt your working hours to your current life situation. Asa contract model, Family & More offers a guarantee of travel-freeweekdays that are contractually fixed. Depending on the reduction oftravel activities, your salary will be adjusted for a fixed period oftime.

Your responsibilitiesAs B2B Manager – Industry & Education , you will build strategic relationships with companies, industry associations, innovation stakeholders, and ecosystem partners across Europe. You will design and implement sponsorship and partnership models that generate income and support financial sustainability, negotiating and closing deals, while creating meaningful connections between industry and talent development initiatives.The role supports two flagship Cross-KIC initiatives: EIT STEM Tech Talent Induction and EIT Talent. EIT STEM Tech Talent Induction is building a STEM talent pipeline through trainings, skilling projects, and a community of industry partners. EIT Talent connects industry with emerging talent through Cross-KIC Innovation Challenges and supports the development of the EIT Alumni Framework and Ambassador Network.You will secure sponsorships, develop partnership opportunities, support innovation challenges, and collaborate with EIT Health, other EIT KICs, industry partners, and European stakeholders in an international environment.Your additional European languages is a plus.What we offer• We are a 100% “Remote First” company, hiring in Germany, Spain, France and Poland.• The possibility to join offices in various locations around healthcare sector, with exposure to high-level and senior representatives from key players and influencers.• The opportunity to work on critical projects of European interest, contributing to improving the lives of citizens and patients.About usEIT Health is one of Europe’s largest and most dynamic health innovation communities, dedicated to improving the lives of citizens and patients and strengthening healthcare systems across the continent.Our mission is simple: to drive healthcare innovation and create positive societal impact across Europe.
